remaining_open_items: The default ST L7805 D2PAK source timed out; its regulator binding remains separate and cannot use MOSFET drain/gate/source roles.
Actual board thermal path, SOA and dynamic failure behavior remain unresolved.
The package reference now has a sourced MOSFET example; this does not validate the regulator default or five-lead variants.
Single-pulse table L0.47 mH differs from note2 L0.48 mH; retain that source discrepancy. Avalanche operation stays unsupported until a sourced pulse/SOA binding replaces the destructive-value guard.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): The default regulator has no re-verified source/functional binding; keep that default blocked. Resolution: The regulator default (ST L7805 D2PAK, BEH-REG-LINEAR) stays blocked, and the ST L78 sheet now archived (ccba643d) cannot change that inside this entry because BEH-REG-LINEAR is not in OHM-101's class list. But the entry's only class is BEH-TRN-MOSFET, the spec's OHM-101 table has a 'power MOSFETs in D2PAK, G-D-S' row that was research_required only because no D2PAK MOSFET sheet had been opened, and IRFZ44NS (D2PAK, archived 6fcd0535) now supplies ratings, Rds(on) test condition and lead assignments (p8 'LEAD ASSIGNMENTS HEXFET 1-GATE 2-DRAIN 3-SOURCE', tab drain). Binding IRFZ44NSPbF by name as an explicit MOSFET alternative mirrors OHM-098 and does not touch the regulator default. Model: the authored IRFZ44N_R6 subcircuit (fit to the TO-220 IRFZ44N, same 55 V / 17.5 mOhm / 2-4 V Vth die rating set) is reused as an explicit proxy; the existing MOSFET probe checks it against the IRFZ44NS's own 17.5 mOhm maximum at VGS 10 V, ID 25 A.
L7805 D2PAK regulator default remains blocked (BEH-REG-LINEAR not in the entry; ST L78 is archived and could serve an IC-stage binding).
Board thermal path, SOA, repetitive avalanche remain unmodelled.
Confirm the library tab terminal label.
